markdown:
# Divider

You might say
These two sections feel cramped. Add a subtle line between them.

**Use a line to separate two different groups of content**·A divider shows that one group has ended and another has begun. It works between list sections, menu groups, and information blocks. If spacing already makes the relationship clear, another line will only make the page feel fragmented.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Reduce rules on the settings page: group Account, Security, and Notifications primarily with headings and block spacing, adding one subtle divider only when needed. Do not rule every row, and verify dark mode and mobile grouping.

### When to use it

- Separate groups in a long list

Basic information

Preferences
- Divide sections inside a menu

Sign-in page designIn progress

Payment-flow reviewCompleted
- Mark a clear change of topic in a compact panel

✎★⬇⋯
- Separate a footer or action area from the content above

Sign in with WeChat QR code
Other sign-in methods

📧📱

### When NOT to use it

- Draw a line between every item in a spacious layout
- Use a divider when [Space](/vibe-hub/space?lang=en) already shows the grouping
- Mix many line colors and weights without meaning
- Use decoration as if it were a real content boundary
